activities.description: Romain Grosjean announces the news of Lewis Hamilton joining Ferrari.
He expresses his surprise and recalls Hamilton's switch from McLaren to Mercedes in 2012.
He talks about Hamilton's motivation for challenges and references the 2012 switch as an example.
He discusses the surprise surrounding the 2012 switch, as Hamilton was closely tied to McLaren.
He mentions McLaren's success at the time and Mercedes's struggles.
He mentions the early challenges Hamilton faced at Mercedes before starting to win in 2013.
He emphasizes the unique and iconic status of Ferrari.
He speculates on Hamilton's motivations for joining Ferrari, suggesting a desire for new challenges.
He comments on Mercedes's slower progress with the new rules post-2021.
He highlights Ferrari being the only team besides Red Bull to win a race in 2023.
He expresses excitement about Hamilton's pairing with Charles Leclerc at Ferrari.

activities.description: Grosjean expresses his excitement for the upcoming F1 seasons, particularly 2024 and 2025.
He reiterates his surprise at Hamilton's move and believes that Hamilton was initially expected to finish his career at Mercedes.
He highlights Fernando Alonso as an example of a driver performing at a high level past the age of 40.
He predicts that many familiar drivers will continue to compete in F1 for a long time.
He concludes by mentioning upcoming car launches and his plans to create a video about the new liveries and cars.
